title: bundle_manifest
description: One built BreakingWeb environment for one kind. Written by abl_envs after a build; read by abl_gates (to judge it) and abl_run (to refuse a run whose served bundle differs). Holds hashes and the recipe, never bundle content (BreakingWeb has no LICENSE). Draft v0: frozen at Stage 0 (READINESS B-4, D-16).

kind.description: clean, none (byte-identical rebuild), a defect kind (landmarks, headings, names_empty, names_fallback, labels, alt, tableheads) or a control (names_tagged, names_plus, names50, labels_sham, *_sham, fmt_wrap, pos_info, pc_break). names is split into names_empty and names_fallback (D-014).

allowed_diffs.description: paths with permitted local edits (breakingweb/app.py and three scripts/*.sh); any other modified tracked file refuses the manifest

content_sha256.description: path-free content hash: sha256 over the sorted (relative path, file sha256) list of static/envs/<env>/ (D-16; the checkout path must not enter it)
